description: Consolidate duplicate email validation logic into a shared utility module. Create src/utils/emailValidator.js with a validateEmail function that uses regex /^[^\s@]+@[^\s@]+\.[^\s@]+$/ and exports it via module.exports. Update these files to import the shared function: src/components/RegistrationForm.js (remove local validateEmail), src/components/LoginForm.js (remove buggy isValidEmail that's missing 'return'), src/services/UserService.js (remove checkEmail method), and src/services/NewsletterService.js (add validation calls). Ensure the shared module has a comment explaining the regex pattern. Remove all duplicate validation logic from the component/service files. Commit your changes with a message about consolidation/refactoring.
